worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.summary: Lifts one opponent off the ground with psychic power: while suspended it cannot move, and Ground moves and terrain hazards cannot reach it.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.use.0: Pin a fleeing opponent in mid-air and focus it
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.use.1: Lift a target out of reach of Ground moves (also protects it from them)
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.use.2: Create a few seconds where attacks connect
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.descriptio: Lift one opponent within %1$s blocks for %2$s s, removing %3$s of its movement; a target that is smacked down or rooted cannot be lifted.
About %1$s psychic rings rise around the target; the count comes from Special Attack.
%1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.pin.on: Pin: at least 92% suppression, nearly rooted, but duration x0.7, cooldown x1.25 and wind-up +3.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.pin.off: Hang: duration x1.15 and cooldown x0.9, cheaper to cast and held longer, but the target can still crawl a step.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.timing: Cast on one opponent; after a %2$s s wind-up it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s s recovery, %5$s s cooldown from commit, current range %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.growth.0: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the lift lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.growth.1: At level %1$s the reach grows to %2$s blocks and the lift lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.telekinesis.preference: On = pin: at least 92% suppression, nearly rooted, but duration x0.7, cooldown x1.25 and wind-up +3. Off = hang: duration x1.15 and cooldown x0.9, held longer but the target can still crawl. Control trades against duration.
The move is considered only when the threat is within this distance; larger means lifting from farther away, smaller means only at close range.
On: only lift targets that still stand on the ground; flying targets are skipped. Off: lift already-airborne targets too.
On: do not lift Fire/Electric/Poison/Rock/Steel-like targets, so their Ground weakness is not shielded. Off: control first, lift them anyway.
On: a holding companion will leave its post to lift the target. Off: it casts only where it already stands.
world_combat.move.telekinesis.text.settl: The hold relaxes, drifting back down
world_combat.move.telekinesis.text.cut: The hold is cut, dropping hard
